n) One of the main reasons for the Airport Spur is to take airport traffic off of the already over-crowded local streets.
This schematic drawing of the proposed Airport Spur was at a small scale and was not intended to show the relocation in detail. Hearing Exhibit B, however, was at a larger scale and showed in detail, all of the relocation.
